elements.name: Red column at the passage-side altar bay

stages.goal: Show the main hall as a complete courtyard-facing building during the requested sideways movement left, ending opposite its left corner.
Return sideways to the right until the open main doorway becomes the clear central destination.
Carry the doorway approach continuously up the steps and well into the enclosed hall, establishing its interior before entry.
Look around the enclosed worship hall through broad, overlapping views that show the requested furnishings as parts of one room.
Withdraw backward through the original doorway while keeping attention on the hall, ending fully outside in the courtyard.
Transfer attention from the hall to the original passage on the right and approach its open entrance from the courtyard.
Enter well into the covered passage and finish with the side of the hall visible within an open longitudinal view.

elements.name: Paved approach to the main entrance steps
elements.caption: The paved apron branches between the planted beds and terminates at the foot of the entrance steps.

elements.name: Main entrance stone steps
elements.caption: Several shallow stone treads rise from the entrance apron to the hall landing.

elements.name: Main hall entrance landing
elements.caption: A narrow raised landing connects the entrance steps to the open timber doorway.

elements.name: Main hall shuttered frontage beside the entrance
elements.caption: Red-brown timber panels and posts form the solid frontage between the hall corner and entrance.

elements.name: Main hall frontage adjoining the covered passage
elements.caption: Timber panels continue from the doorway to the covered-passage junction, partly screened by a leafy tree.

elements.name: Open main hall doorway
elements.caption: An open rectangular doorway connects the raised landing to the dim hall.

elements.name: Planted courtyard bed beside the passage
elements.caption: A grass-covered bed holds the supported tree, shrubs and ornamental stones beside the passage approach.

elements.name: Supported tree in the passage-side planting bed
elements.caption: A leafy tree screens the facade, with angled stakes forming a broad obstacle around its trunk.

elements.name: Planting bed beside the hall courtyard corner
elements.caption: A planted strip separates the hall corner from the outer courtyard paving.

elements.name: Tree in the hall-corner planting bed
elements.caption: A supported leafy tree occupies the planted strip beside the hall corner.

elements.name: Stone lantern beside the entrance apron
elements.caption: A pale stone lantern on a pedestal marks the edge of the entrance approach.

elements.name: Stone lantern beside the hall-corner bed
elements.caption: A matching stone lantern stands beside the planted strip along the courtyard path.

elements.name: Covered passage stone floor
elements.caption: Raised stone paving runs through the open roofed passage alongside the temple hall.

elements.name: Courtyard steps into the covered passage
elements.caption: Shallow stone steps connect the courtyard paving to the raised passage floor.

elements.name: Round red column at the passage entrance
elements.caption: A substantial red cylindrical column supports the passage roof and constrains the entrance route.

elements.name: Red pier at the hall and passage junction
elements.caption: A red structural pier marks the junction of the hall frontage and covered passage.

elements.name: Open entrance to the covered passage
elements.caption: The gap between the hall-junction pier and round column opens onto the roofed passage.

elements.name: Enclosed main hall stone floor
elements.caption: A modest enclosed hall has worn gray stone paving, a clear central viewing area and a gilded altar opposite the entrance. Daylight entering through the doorway leaves the room progressively dimmer within.

elements.name: Main hall wall opposite the entrance
elements.caption: An uninterrupted dark red-brown timber enclosure closes the hall beyond the altar. Subdued panel divisions provide a quiet background to the gilded statue, with no doorway or onward passage.

elements.name: Main hall courtyard-corner side wall
elements.caption: Pale plaster encloses the courtyard-corner side of the hall, with shallow vertical divisions above dark wall-side offering furniture.

elements.name: Main hall passage-side wall
elements.caption: A solid red-brown timber wall encloses the passage side of the hall. Its exterior continues the temple's restrained paneling and is visible obliquely from the roofed stone passage.

elements.name: Main hall timber ceiling
elements.caption: Dark timber beams and a continuous ceiling close the hall overhead. The subdued structure supports hanging lanterns and keeps the interior recognizably enclosed rather than open to the sky.

elements.name: Altar platform opposite the main entrance
elements.caption: A pale stepped altar plinth supports the gilded figure opposite the entrance, surrounded by clear gray paving and dark offering furniture.

elements.name: Gilded statue facing the main entrance
elements.caption: A gilded sacred figure rests on the altar platform, facing the main doorway. Its warm gold surface catches restrained entrance daylight and remains the principal focus of the dim hall.

elements.name: Offering table with candlesticks on the courtyard-corner side
elements.caption: A dark wooden offering table stands before the altar on the courtyard-corner side of the central aisle. A pair of slender metal candlesticks rests on its top, leaving the central view unobstructed.

elements.name: Offering table with candlesticks on the passage side
elements.caption: A matching dark wooden offering table occupies the passage side of the central aisle before the altar. Slender metal candlesticks repeat the restrained arrangement on the other table.

elements.name: Red column at the courtyard-corner entrance bay
elements.caption: A round red timber column rises from the stone floor to the dark overhead beams on the courtyard-corner side of the entrance half of the hall.

elements.name: Red column at the courtyard-corner altar bay
elements.caption: A second round red column continues the courtyard-corner row toward the altar, standing between the solid side enclosure and the offering-table area.

elements.name: Red column at the passage-side entrance bay
elements.caption: A round red timber column marks the passage-side row within the entrance half of the hall. It frames the broad interior view without narrowing the doorway.

elements.name: Red column at the passage-side altar bay
elements.caption: A matching red column continues the passage-side interior row toward the altar. The solid timber side wall remains visible beyond it in broad views across the room.

elements.name: Hanging lantern over the entrance half of the hall
elements.caption: A subdued red-and-gold lantern hangs above the entrance half of the central hall floor. Its traditional form echoes the exterior lanterns without overpowering the natural doorway light.

elements.name: Hanging lantern over the altar half of the hall
elements.caption: A second traditional red-and-gold lantern hangs over the altar half of the central floor, visible together with the statue, columns and dark ceiling in an open interior composition.

elements.name: Stone floor of the hall-end covered walk
elements.caption: Gray stone paving continues straight through successive open-sided temple roof bays, with shaded depth ahead and courtyard daylight along the outer edge.

elements.name: Timber roof over the hall-end covered walk
elements.caption: Dark timber roofing and repeated crossbeams extend the passage shade above continuous stone paving. The courtyard side remains open to soft daylight.

elements.name: Red post at the hall-end passage roof bay
elements.caption: A muted red timber post supports the outer edge of the continued passage roof, leaving broad clear paving beneath the beams.

elements.name: Red post at the courtyard beam joint of the covered walk
elements.caption: A matching red timber post meets a roof beam along the open courtyard edge. Shaded stone paving continues unobstructed beside it.

elements.name: Red post at the third hall-end roof bay
elements.caption: A muted red timber post meets a crossbeam at the open courtyard edge of the covered walk, leaving the shaded center unobstructed.

elements.name: Red post at the fourth hall-end roof bay
elements.caption: A matching red timber post supports another roof bay along the open courtyard edge. Continuous gray paving remains clear beneath the dark beams.

elements.name: Lawn along the temple covered-walk garden
elements.caption: A sunlit strip of green lawn borders the open side of the timber-roofed stone walk. The paving remains the walking surface, contrasting with the softer garden ground.

elements.name: Tree and shrub belt at the temple garden boundary
elements.caption: Leafy trees and dense low shrubs form the garden backdrop beyond the lawn. Muted green foliage catches the same hazy daylight seen through the open temple passage.
